description: Ministry Of Agriculture and Plantation Industries - Control of Pesticides Act. No.33 of 1980, Amended Extra Gazette No.1655/17 of 25.05.2010
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980, specifically amending existing regulations related to pest control services licensing fees and renewal procedures. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory amendments to existing legislation. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
